roster.genderEvidence: Historical identity in captured official biography; no machine gender field or live client inspection claimed.

officialSkills.name: 罪论
officialSkills.body: 结束阶段，你可以观看牌堆顶三张牌，然后获得其中X张牌，将剩余牌以任意顺序置于牌堆顶（X为你满足的项数：1.本回合造成过伤害；2.本回合未弃置过牌；3.手牌数全场最少）。若均不满足，你与一名其他角色失去1点体力。

officialSkills.name: 父荫
officialSkills.body: 锁定技，当你每回合首次成为其他角色【杀】或【决斗】的目标后，若其手牌数不小于你，此牌对你无效。

roster.name: 陈到
roster.genderEvidence: Historical identity in captured official biography; no machine gender field or live client inspection claimed.

officialSkills.name: 往烈
officialSkills.body: 你出牌阶段使用的首张牌无距离限制。当你于出牌阶段使用基本牌或普通锦囊牌时，你可以令此牌不能被响应，然后你本阶段不能再使用牌。

roster.name: 孙亮
roster.genderEvidence: Historical identity in captured official biography; no machine gender field or live client inspection claimed.

officialSkills.name: 溃诛
officialSkills.body: 弃牌阶段结束时，你可以选择一项：1.令至多X名角色各摸一张牌；2.对任意名体力值之和为X的角色各造成1点伤害。（X为你本阶段弃置的牌数）

officialSkills.name: 掣政
officialSkills.body: 锁定技，你防止于你的出牌阶段对攻击范围内不包含你的角色造成的伤害。出牌阶段结束时，若你本阶段使用的牌数小于这些角色数，你弃置其中一名角色一张牌。

officialSkills.name: 立军
officialSkills.body: 主公技，其他吴势力角色出牌阶段限一次，当其使用【杀】后，其可以令你获得之，然后你可以令其摸一张牌且此回合使用【杀】的限制次数+1。

zhuge-zhan: Freeze X from live whole-actual-turn damage, actual owned HEJ discard occurrences, and minimum living hand count (ties qualify) at private peek execution. Existing discard-origin reason classification excludes uses/responses/death/replacement/recast; discard attribution follows the physical owned source, including imposed discards. This attribution is an engineering choice, not a captured FAQ.

Peek up to three actual top entities privately; obtain exactly min(X, available count), reorder remaining only at the top, and await real gains without re-obtaining moved entities. First designation across Slash family and Duel is registered independently of the hand comparison and grant suppression/loss; one genuine use is counted once.

For X0 select the other living participant before loss; use actual loss-of-HP/dying continuations for both participants, with precommitted owner-first sequence and game-completion boundaries. Do not replace loss with damage, scalar HP editing, or broad dead-source/Processing relaxations.
chen-dao: First used card is per actual own Play-phase instance, including equipment and one virtual/multi-cost use, excluding played responses. Apply ignore-distance before physical payment and in both human and AI legality.

No-response belongs to the exact issued CardUseAction; cover Dodge, Duel, both AOE responses, Nullification and Borrowed Sword request response according to existing typed response protocols. Ordinary effect choices, reveal/discard interactions and unrelated rescue/skill windows remain active.

After accepted activation prohibit subsequent card uses through the same actual Play-phase instance, including response uses but excluding played responses. Issued prohibition lasts to phase end after source loss/suppression, with recorded source identity; no shortcut EndPlay or turn-wide prohibition. These response/issued-effect choices are explicit engineering boundaries without a captured FAQ.

Use captured www.sanguosha.com/hero/409 first-card/basic-or-ordinary-trick/cannot-use text. Other product x.sanguosha.com/hero/98.html has first-two-to-others and different restrictions and is excluded.
sun-liang: Count true HEJ discard occurrences across the entire actual own discard-phase instance, using owned physical discard origins and excluding uses/responses/death/replacement/recast. Count each real occurrence rather than distinct IDs or cards still in DiscardPile. This owned-source attribution is an explicit engineering choice.

Freeze discard X, chosen mode, target set and HP-sum budget before executing effects; allow owner in the target set. Damage participants must have positive HP at selection so the combination space stays bounded; X0 supports no-effect draw/skip, not a nonempty zero-HP damage set. These edge choices are not a captured FAQ.
Use live target attack range containing source (not the reverse), own actual Play-phase use count, and true BeforeDamage prevention including chain events; never prevent HP loss.

Provider controls giving genuine completed Slash-family costs; Lord controls optional reward after transfer and movement children. Gift only still-available actual costs in their action processing/discard domain, never recover from another hand. No physical cost means no gift.

Provider uses Lijun once per actual own Play-phase instance across eligible Lords/grant instances, consumed on accepted gift. Preserve exact Lord source, Wu provider, phase/action/cost provenance and live participant/grant checks; draw then issue recipient SlashLimit+1 through the current actual turn. These multiple-source/continuation choices are explicit engineering boundaries.
